notes.title: DAMNAZE UPDATE 1.1 :
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34109085/327467fa8a9743cbce0161392862612fb415a8e6.jpg[/img]
New:
- Now you can find a shotgun 
- New atmosphere
- Now you can interact with more objects

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where the player could not open a green sector door
- Fixed an issue when hunger went less than zero when the player was caught by a creature 

Gameplay :
- Improved flashlight lighting
- Added food and battery model

notes.title: Coming soon in DAMNAZE
notes.content:
Soon there will be a shotgun in the game that will help you to kill those creatures.To get it you need to find the key from the closet in the orange sector and open it.[b]Stay with us![/b]
